PLAN "Return to Skiing: 12-Week Knee-Safe Strength"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build lower-body and trunk strength for skiing, without jumping or deep loaded knee flexion"
  GOAL secondary return_to_sport:
    name "Restore knee confidence and tolerance for skiing next season"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Lower Foundation":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          romanian_deadlift 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          leg_press 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x30 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 3m
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Upper Body":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x8..10 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 3m
          chest_stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Hip and Core":
        warmup:
          elliptical 8m
        main straight_sets:
          trap_bar_deadlift 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          hip_abduction 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          pallof_press 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 3x8..10 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          side_plank 3x20 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          glute_bridge 2m
          butterfly_stretch 3m
